games.description: A solo vacation turned into a beaver horror story. Sark searches the cabin and bunker for tools and keys, struggles with a crowbar puzzle, and works through the final pursuit to the ending.
games.title: Don't Mess With Bober

games.description: A solo run through a self-aware parody with its developer in chat. Sark faces platforming traps, the spider’s questions, computer-clock puzzles, the only-up climb and a timed bomb. After many attempts at the optional final boss, he takes the offered skip route to the ending and credits, then tests more settings.
